prompt:
Design compositional option 1 of 3 for the first viewport of the real Chinese desktop web application “Flacier Rules”, at 1440×900 landscape. Use both reference images only as design-language sources: the atlas reference contributes its restrained navy/teal/off-white palette, paper-flat material, editorial index, typography character, and continuous-sheet composition; the railway reference contributes only its functional interlocking route line, junction logic, and signal-state feedback. Do not copy either reference layout exactly. The product is a personal proxy routing rule and subscription tool, not a marketing landing page and not a railway fan site.

OPTION 1 — 线路总图. Build one continuous interface sheet. A thin top navigation has “Flacier Rules”, “订阅”, “网址测试”, “规则转换”, “策略”, “规则”, “GitHub”. The first viewport title is “从网址看到出口”, with the short line “输入网址，查看命中的规则、策略和地区。” The dominant region is a large horizontal operational route across roughly two-thirds of the viewport: URL field containing “https://api.openai.com/v1/models”, action “检查路线”, then an interlocking line with four named stations in this exact order: “api.openai.com” → “AI.list” → “AI” → “美国节点”. Above each station use small functional code labels “DOMAIN / RULE SET / POLICY / EXIT”. The active path is teal with filled signal dots; alternate paths are thin charcoal sidings ending at quiet red stop dots. No locomotive, train, platform photography, station architecture, or decorative railway props.

The right third is a rule atlas index, dense but readable: rows AI, Steam, Discord, Bilibili, AniGamer, with policy columns and a compact country selector “香港 / 新加坡 / 日本 / 台湾 / 美国”, 美国 selected. The bottom begins a wide subscription strip with one URL field and client labels “Mihomo / sing-box / Surge / Stash / Shadowrocket / Loon / Quantumult X”. Include the factual note “默认：GLOBAL · 进程规则需在客户端检查”.

World: cool off-white paper, deep navy lines and type, one teal active route, pale blue-green selected fields, muted red only for stop/error. Absolutely no orange, yellow, gold, gradients, glass blur, glows, black cyberpunk background, floating rounded SaaS cards, fake metrics, emoji, decorative section numbers, eyebrow text, huge marketing hero, or third-party logos. Modern condensed workhorse grotesk for headings, neutral grotesk for UI, mono only for URLs and code labels. Thin 1px rules, mostly square corners, no shadow. The route diagram must be the strongest visible element; the index and subscription strip stay quiet. Make it feel buildable in semantic React/CSS/SVG.
